description: This file contains locale and culture-specific settings and extensions for the Datejs library tailored for Czech (Czech Republic). It defines date and time formats, names, regex patterns, and prototype methods for date manipulation and parsing in Czech.

classes.name: Date.CultureInfo
classes.description: An object holding culture-specific information about date and time formats for Czech (Czech Republic).

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Clears the time component of a Date object, setting hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the current date object’s time to the current system time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Returns a new Date object with the same timestamp as the current one.
